invariants.name: assert_new_thread_id
invariants.sql:
SELECT count(*)::int AS c FROM execution_contexts
          WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND thread_id = $2 AND created_at >= $3

invariants.name: assert_tenant_filtered_results
invariants.sql:
SELECT tenant_id, count(*)::int AS c FROM memory_items
          WHERE idempotency_key LIKE $1
          GROUP BY tenant_id

invariants.name: assert_no_cross_thread_execution_state_resume
invariants.sql:
SELECT count(*)::int AS c FROM execution_contexts
          WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND thread_id = $2 AND created_at >= $3
